Brivycme are names (typically prefixed by '''la''') that take the form of brivla instead of cmevla. Some brivycme may take the form of words that do not have a defined meaning otherwise.

They are often preferred for calqued / translated (rather than transliterated) names, as they do not require pauses, and won't cause possible ambiguity between consonant-final rafsi and added final consonants. (e.g. is '''la .mamtas.''' derived from '''mamta''', or '''mamta tansi'''?)

As brivycme cannot currently be entered into [http://jbovlaste.lojban.org/ jbovlaste], here is a list of common brivycme used (feel free to add more, but keep the alphabetical order)

* '''la dontu'u''' : YouTube (video-sharing website)
* '''la dzapre''' : [http://jbovlaste.lojban.org/dict/samyuan "Someone"], the god of lazy people
* '''la faglo'u''' : Firefox (web browser)
* '''la flicku''' : Facebook (social media website)
* '''la gadganzu''': The [[http://mw.lojban.org/papri/zipcpi:_Yet_another_gadri_article gadganzu proposal]]
* '''la jbovlaste''': [http://jbovlaste.lojban.org/ Jbovlaste], community-maintained Lojban dictionary
* '''la kakpyzba''' : Minecraft (game)
* '''la lobyuitki''': This very wiki
* '''la romge''' : Chrome (web browser)
